create_CpmAntConfig: create a CPMAnt model configuration with default hyperparameters for the cpm-ant-10b style model
configure_CpmAntConfig: configure a CPMAnt model with custom vocab_size, hidden_size, and num_hidden_layers settings
initialize_CpmAntModel: initialize a CPMAnt model from a CpmAntConfig configuration instance
access_model_config: access the model configuration via the model.config attribute
set_position_bias: set position_bias_num_buckets and position_bias_max_distance for CPMAnt positional encoding
